commands.name: call
commands.description: Call an editor method and print its JSON result. params is a JSON object, '-' to read it from standard input, or @<file> to read it from a file. Commands that take frames answer when they finish; --timeout (default 30000 ms) bounds the wait. --save-image writes an image result ({"Image": {"MimeType", "Data"}}) to a file and prints its path instead of the data

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the editor's methods and their descriptions (--json: with parameter schemas)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show whether an editor is reachable, and the known editor sessions

commands.name: launch
commands.description: Start an editor (for a project, if given) and wait until it accepts connections (at most --wait-timeout, default 60000 ms), then until the project is ready: its assets scanned and its start scene open, printing the progress to stderr, for as long as it progresses (it fails when nothing progressed for --stall-timeout seconds, default 60). --no-wait-scan returns once it accepts connections. It keeps running until 'call editor.quit', or until no client has been connected for --idle-timeout seconds. --headless runs without a window, --no-gpu also without a graphics device; --window-size opens a window of exactly that many pixels (at least 640x360) and --ui-scale draws the UI at that scale (1 is 100%) instead of the display's: with both, screenshots of the editor compare across machines

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Serve the Model Context Protocol on stdin/stdout (for AI agents). Editors it starts close themselves after --idle-timeout seconds without a client (default 600, 0: never). Only the commands of --toolsets are tools (default core: about 30; all: every command); the tools strata_describe and strata_toolsets show and enable the others, strata_call runs any

connection.name: --port <n>
connection.description: Explicit endpoint (else STRATA_EDITOR_PORT), authenticated with the STRATA_EDITOR_TOKEN environment variable (preferred) or --token <t>

connection.name: --project <dir>
connection.description: The editor that has this project open (<dir>/.strata/EditorSession.json)

connection.name: (none)
connection.description: The newest running editor session that accepts a connection

connection.name: --host <address>
connection.description: Host of the explicit endpoint (default 127.0.0.1; requires --port)

environment.name: STRATA_EDITOR_PATH
environment.description: Editor executable for launch/mcp (default: StrataEditor next to StrataCLI)

environment.name: STRATA_SESSION_DIR
environment.description: Private directory of editor session files (default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Strata\Sessions, ~/.local/share/Strata/Sessions or ~/Library/Application Support/Strata/Sessions)

StrataCLI.exitCodes: 0 success; 1 the editor answered with an error; 2 no editor reachable or the connection was lost; 3 invalid command line; 4 no answer within --timeout (the command may still be running in the editor: do not start another one); 5 --save-image could not save the image.
